title: rbac v2: enforce KMS region pinning + audit log augmentation
author: Priya Menon
description:
Motivation: Enforce data residency constraints at the RBAC v2 layer and ensure KMS key usage is pinned to allowed regions for private deployments. This change hardens policy evaluation to reject requests that try to use keys outside the principal's allowed region set and surfaces KMS metadata in audit logs for improved post-incident forensics.

What this PR does: Adds enforcement for region_pin attributes on RBAC v2 roles and service accounts; augments audit events with kms_key_id and kms_region when present; migrates existing RBAC policy documents to include an explicit region_pin field in audit mode where missing; and exposes a feature-flag to toggle strict enforcement per-tenant.

Checklist:
- [x] Policy evaluation changes in the auth service
- [x] Audit log schema and storage update
- [x] Migration script for existing policies (audit-mode default)
- [x] End-to-end e2e tests covering cross-region key rejection
- [x] Console flag + docs for ops to enable enforcement

Backwards compatibility: Migration defaults to audit-mode to avoid immediate enforcement. Admins can flip per-tenant feature-flag to enable strict enforcement after rollout.

Related Linear/Jira: ENG-8123, SUP-441. See design doc link: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-8123/rbac-v2-region-pinning-design

Notes on risk: Policy evaluation path touches auth and request dispatch; added unit+integration tests to cover hot paths. Rollout plan includes a staged enablement and monitoring dashboard for enforcement-related rejects.

feat: augment audit logger with kms_key_id + kms_region fields

docs: add runbook and admin docs for feature-flag and rollout

release_notes: Add enforcement for RBAC v2 region pinning for KMS usage. Audit logs now include kms_key_id and kms_region. Migration backfills region_pin in audit-mode by default. Admins can enable strict enforcement via tenant feature-flag.
review_thread: Ethan Clarke (reviewer): Please validate that the middleware short-circuits before kernel selection to avoid wasted GPU allocation when enforcement rejects a request. Request adding a fast-path check in request router.
Priya Menon (author): Added early reject in router and updated evaluator to be O(1) for common case (no region_pin). See services/auth/src/middleware/region_pin.go commit.

Rosa Alvarez (reviewer): Migration looks good; suggest running it in dry-run against staging and surfacing counts in the admin console before enabling enforcement. Also asked to add metric enforcement.rejects_by_tenant.
Priya Menon (author): Added dry-run flag to migration and new metric enforcement.rejects_by_tenant + dashboard tile. Updated docs with rollout steps.
Samuel Kwan (security review): Confirmed audit events include kms_key_id and kms_region and that PII is not exposed. Approved.
CI Bot: e2e failed on first run due to timing issue in test harness; tests rerun and passed.
Maintainer (merge): Squash merge after green CI and two approvals.
changelog_entry: security: enforce RBAC v2 region pinning for KMS keys; audit log augmentation; migration in audit-mode
testing_notes: Unit tests added for policy evaluator; integration tests validate audit event schema; e2e simulates cross-region KMS call and asserts rejection under enforcement flag. Staging migration run in dry-run mode produced 183 policies to be backfilled.
ops_runbook: See docs/ops/rbac-region-pinning.md for rollout. Recommended phased enablement: 1) run migration in dry-run, 2) enable enforcement for 10% tenant sample, 3) monitor enforcement.rejects_by_tenant and audit logs for false positives, 4) expand rollout.
security_impact: Positive: reduces risk of accidental cross-region key usage and strengthens audit trails. No new secrets introduced. Feature gated per-tenant.
